steps.title: Exchange correct proof
preconditions: Isolated unchanged Worker, synthetic state and exact local GitHub simulation; earlier ordered steps passed.
actions: POST exchange correct verifier after failures

expectations.description: After a wrong verifier failed without consumption, correct proof returns a session with the exact persisted synthetic identity and the verified primary email chosen from competing fixture addresses.

mappings.why: The exact local token/profile/email requests return competing unverified-primary and verified-secondary addresses; subsequent exchange asserts only the verified primary email is selected. All behavior is simulated, not live GitHub.

The returned exchange code is accepted by the next correct-proof exchange; its response independently asserts the persisted synthetic name, selected email, null avatar and usable user identity. No existing-account upsert or storage-error branch is claimed.

Correct proof succeeds after the immediately preceding wrong proof returns invalid_code, independently proving wrong proof did not consume this code. Issued session has exact synthetic identity; no real GitHub login.
